p: Rephidim: Moses does not note every place where they camped as in Numbers 33, but only those places where some notable thing was done.
tempt the LORD: Why do you distrust God? Why do you not look for comfort from him without complaining to us?
stone me: How ready the people are to slay the true prophets for their own purposes and how slow they are to take up God's cause against his enemies and false prophets.
LORD among us: When in adversity we think God is absent, then we neglect his promise and make him a liar.
Amalek: Who came from Eliphaz, son of Esau, Ge 36:12.
hill with the rod of God: That is, Horeb, which is also called Sinai.
down his hand: So that we see how dangerous a thing it is to cease in prayer.
in a book: In the book of the law.
Jehovahnissi: That is, the Lord is my banner as he declared by holding up his rod and his hands.
